text:
maya: quick heads-up — i'm going to enable a short lived route mask for /v1/generate to divert ~10% traffic to `route-v2` while we verify quota buckets. hitting this because upstream client started spiking and quota alarms are flapping :rotating_light:

sam: @maya do you have the quota numbers? which buckets are at risk? :eyes:

maya: overall tenant quota at 92% (rolling 1h). per-route burst for legacy model is at 98% for a couple clients. i want to flip 10% of new requests with header `x-rw-route: route-v2` so we can validate behavior without failing users. plan is 10m canary then scale back based on telemetry.

ops-bot: automated check: 
- recent quota alerts: tenant-123 (92%), tenant-87 (89%)
- error rate increase (legacy): +0.4% over baseline
- current routing config sha: a1b2c3
runbook: https://internal/runbooks/routing-emergency

leo: sounds fine. how are you toggling it? admin toggle endpoint or envoy header rewrite?

maya: admin toggle. i'll run the toggle endpoint with auth token and set pct=10. will post curl.

maya: running now — posting command for audit:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/v1/toggles/route_mask" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"route": "/v1/generate", "variant": "route-v2", "pct": 10, "reason": "quota sanity canary"}'
```

ops-bot: toggle accepted. id=toggle-202603. canary start: 2026-03-20T15:17:30Z. telemetry job id=tele-7788.

tori: can you add a temporary dashboard panel to show: legacy qps, v2 qps, error rate, avg latency, and quota remaining? i want a chart for tenants >50k monthly.

maya: added a panel under Console > Temp > route-mask-canary. link: https://console.internal/dashboards/route-mask-canary

adrian: quick sanity checks to run: 
- tail the gateway logs for `route-mask` header hits: `kubectl logs -f gateway-xxx | grep route-mask`
- confirm KV cache warmup on v2: look for `kvcache.warmup: true` in logs
- check latency p50/p95 on both variants

leo: also watch quota utilization API: `GET https://admin.internal/v1/quotas?tenant=...` refresh every 20s. if any tenant > 95% abort and rollback.

maya: seeing ~8% of traffic on route-v2 already. no errors so far. p95 latency +10ms, p50 +2ms. tenants still under 93%.

sam: good. if anything spikes run the kill-switch:
```bash
# immediate rollback (kill-switch)
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/v1/toggles/route_mask/kill" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"\n```

maya: noted. i'll keep monitoring for 10m and then either scale to 25% or rollback to 0 depending on quota and errors. i'll update this thread at 5m and 10m. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: 5m telemetry snapshot: canary pct=10, v2 errors=0.2%, legacy errors=0.45%, overall quota=90-93%.

maya: interim update: traffic stable. bumping to 25% paused — want to wait for one more 5m window to ensure quota buffer holds.

adrian: reminder — if we do bump, set a circuit window to auto-revert after 15m unless cleared. also tag the toggle with `canary-owner:maya`.

maya: OK tagged. setting auto-revert to 15m if bumped.

leo: thumbs up. keep an eye on the downstream billing meter too — sudden usage could overrun committed capacity.

maya: closing loop: at 10m canary completed, no regressions, quotas steady. i'll promote route-v2 to 25% for another 20m, then either 50% or rollback. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

sam: nice work. please file a small post-incident note with timestamps and the toggle id for the team.

maya: will do — i'll create a short note in #postmortems with toggle-202603 details.
